messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: connectBluetooth
function.description: Establishes a connection to a Bluetooth device using its name. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

device_name.description: The name of the Bluetooth device to connect to.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to attempt a connection before timing out.

auto_reconnect.description: Whether to automatically attempt to reconnect if the connection is lost.

message.content:
Here’s a quick rundown of the **federal public‑holiday long weekends** that fell in Canada during 2023. (If you’re looking at a specific province, keep in mind that many provinces add their own holidays—see the “Provinces” section below.)

| Date(s) | Holiday | Notes |
|---------|---------|-------|
| **Jan 1–3** | New Year’s Day (observed Mon Feb 2) | New Year’s Day was on Sunday Jan 1, so the statutory holiday was observed on Monday Jan 2. The weekend plus the observed day makes a 3‑day break. |
| **Feb 20** | Family Day (Ontario, BC, AB, NB, PEI, SK) | Falls on a Monday – a classic long weekend. |
| **Apr 7** | Good Friday | Friday – gives a 3‑day weekend. |
| **May 22** | Victoria Day | Monday – long weekend. |
| **Jul 1–3** | Canada Day (observed Mon Jul 3) | Canada Day was on Saturday Jul 1; the statutory holiday was observed on Monday Jul 3. The weekend plus the observed day creates a 3‑day break. |
| **Sep 4** | Labour Day | Monday – long weekend. |
| **Oct 9** | Thanksgiving | Monday – long weekend. |
| **Dec 25–27** | Christmas Day (observed Mon Dec 26) | Christmas Day was on Monday Dec 25, so the statutory holiday was observed on Monday. The weekend plus the observed day gives a 3‑day break. |

### Provincial variations

| Province | Extra long‑weekend holidays in 2023 |
|----------|-------------------------------------|
| **Alberta** | None beyond the federal list |
| **British Columbia** | None beyond the federal list |
| **Manitoba** | None beyond the federal list |
| **New Brunswick** | None beyond the federal list |
| **Newfoundland & Labrador** | St. Patricks’ Day (Mar 17) – falls on a Wednesday, so not a long weekend |
| **Nova Scotia** | None beyond the federal list |
| **Ontario** | Family Day (Feb 20) – already listed |
| **Prince Edward Island** | None beyond the federal list |
| **Quebec** | None beyond the federal list |
| **Saskatchewan** | None beyond the federal list |

> **Tip:** If you’re building a holiday‑planning app, you may want to let users toggle provincial calendars so they see all relevant long weekends for their location.
